title: Why Can't You TICKLE Yourself?
description:
Why can't you tickle yourself, when someone else can make you fall apart?

Pip is six years old and undefeated. So this week her uncle has a plan: tickle himself every day until he's immune. The problem is his own brain. It predicts every touch he makes and turns it down before he feels it. In this animated short you'll see the tickle robot that broke the rule, the push experiment that explains every "he pushed me first" fight, and the rats that chirp when you tickle them.

It's a short film about a feather and a niece, and about the one kind of touch your brain can't see coming.
